title: Observation does not imply operational authority
context: Sakayanagi permitted limited visit to White Room
information_available: Observes children and learns assertions by researchers, his own family values
perceived_objective: Understand institution while raising ethical objections
observed_actions: Challenges the humanitarian effects of Suzukake's educational methods and the suppression of children's emotional development, then questions the ethics of institutional isolation.
observed_result: Expresses misgivings to Atsuomi without acquiring institutional rule-setting authority.
epistemic_limits: The innate-aptitude/DNA theory during the later observation visit is proposed by Arisu, not by her father; his response keeps nature versus nurture uncertain. Do not attribute her feat to him.
memory_seed_policy: Never import the canonical episode as an occurrence after a simulation divergence; pre-existing skills may be used only in character-behavioral calibration
